Later commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 preserved the same guidance while updating the link to questionnaire-core.html during build-source refactoring. Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-5742 plus Questionnaire/common-extension terms found no contrary community evidence.
